```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 300)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(here, ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr, scales, flexsurv, survival)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9)))
```

```{r load-analysis, include=FALSE}
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/03_biomarker_strategies.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/06_parametric_survival_analysis.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/07_basecase_input_parameters.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/functions/model_fun.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/functions/calculate_outcomes.R"))
}))
```

```{r run-dsa, include=FALSE}
dsa_pars <- c("c_drug_nivo", "c_drug_FLOX", "c_test_NGS", "c_test_CT",
              "c_test_blood", "c_other_visit", "c_other_baseline",
              "c_other_follow", "c_other_last", "u_np", "u_p",
              "p_crp", "p_tmb_braf")

dsa_ranges <- data.frame(
  pars = dsa_pars,
  min = unlist(l_params_base[dsa_pars]) * (1 - DSA_mult),
  max = unlist(l_params_base[dsa_pars]) * (1 + DSA_mult),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (param in c("u_np", "u_p")) {
  idx <- which(dsa_ranges$pars == param)
  dsa_ranges$max[idx] <- min(dsa_ranges$max[idx], 1.0)
}
for (param in c("p_crp", "p_tmb_braf")) {
  idx <- which(dsa_ranges$pars == param)
  dsa_ranges$min[idx] <- max(dsa_ranges$min[idx], 0.0)
  dsa_ranges$max[idx] <- min(dsa_ranges$max[idx], 1.0)
}
for (param in dsa_pars[grepl("^c_", dsa_pars)]) {
  idx <- which(dsa_ranges$pars == param)
  dsa_ranges$min[idx] <- max(dsa_ranges$min[idx], 0)
}

base_result <- model_fun(l_params_base)
base_result$NMB <- base_result$Effect * WTP - base_result$Cost
base_inmb <- base_result$NMB[base_result$Strategy == "crp"] -
  base_result$NMB[base_result$Strategy == "control"]

tornado_data <- data.frame()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(dsa_ranges))) {
  param_name <- dsa_ranges$pars[i]
  for (value_type in c("min", "max")) {
    params_varied <- l_params_base
    params_varied[[param_name]] <- dsa_ranges[[value_type]][i]

    result <- model_fun(params_varied)
    result$NMB <- result$Effect * WTP - result$Cost

    inmb <- result$NMB[result$Strategy == "crp"] -
      result$NMB[result$Strategy == "control"]

    tornado_data <- rbind(tornado_data, data.frame(
      Parameter = param_name,
      Value = value_type,
      INMB = inmb,
      INMB_Diff = inmb - base_inmb,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

tornado_wide <- tornado_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Value, values_from = INMB_Diff) %>%
  mutate(Range = pmax(abs(min), abs(max))) %>%
  arrange(Range)

parameter_labels <- c(
  c_drug_nivo = "Nivolumab cost",
  c_drug_FLOX = "FLOX cost",
  c_test_NGS = "NGS test cost",
  c_test_CT = "CT scan cost",
  c_test_blood = "Blood test cost",
  c_other_visit = "Visit cost",
  c_other_baseline = "Baseline cost",
  c_other_follow = "Follow-up cost",
  c_other_last = "End-of-life cost",
  u_np = "Utility: progression-free",
  u_p = "Utility: progressed",
  p_crp = "CRP prevalence",
  p_tmb_braf = "TMB/BRAF prevalence"
)

tornado_wide$Label <- parameter_labels[tornado_wide$Parameter]
tornado_wide$Label <- factor(tornado_wide$Label, levels = tornado_wide$Label)
```

```{r figure, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
p_tornado <- ggplot(tornado_wide) +
  geom_col(aes(x = Label, y = min), fill = "#3B6EA8", alpha = 0.85, width = 0.7) +
  geom_col(aes(x = Label, y = max), fill = "#B55343", alpha = 0.85, width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Change in incremental NMB: CRP-guided vs standard care (EUR)") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "EUR ", big.mark = ",")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_tornado)
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
figs_dir <- here("figs")
if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(here("figs", "figure2.png"), p_tornado, width = 9, height = 7,
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

Figure 2 has been saved to `figs/figure2.png`.
